resources.string: Choose how to send the file to your computer.
Tap Connect computer and send the file to your computer. Finish with the computer setup guide below.
In the list, choose Tailscale, then choose your computer.
1. Connect this phone and your computer
Turn on Tailscale on both devices using the same account, or connect both to the same Wi-Fi.
Your computer can read and change only the calendars you tick. This one-time permission stays until you tap Unpair computer.
Tap Connect computer. Choose Tailscale, then your computer in the share list. Finish with the computer setup guide below.
Your computer can use the calendars below while the connection is on.
Keep this on while your computer works with your calendar.
